export: ODOT SAFE-T 'Export Collisions' (CSV/Excel, one row per collision, fields picked by check box), or an OCERS extract from OHSO
spec: No public column list. SAFE-T Training (ODOT, Aug 2018, https://www.odot.org/traffic/files/safe-t-training.pdf, saved in ~/.hermes/state-manuals/ok/): 'Most exports are in the form of a table with one line for every crash report and one column for every data field selected' (p. 103); 'Download User Data Dictionary can be useful for determining the meaning of codes' (p. 109); 'Each collision has a unique Collision ID ... Each Unit and Person has a unique ID' (pp. 112-113).
layout_seen_live: SAFE-T-derived public layers show the field names to expect: ODOT AllCollisions_2012_2021 and INCOG Crashes2017_2023 (County, City, Control, Int_ID, Milepoint, Hwy_Name, Hwy_Class, Int_Rel, Num_Killed, Type_of_Collision, Severity, Date, Latitude_Derived, Longitude_Derived, Collision_ID, On_Street, At_Street ...), OKC VZAP (ON_STREET, AT_STREET, SEVERITY_C 1-5, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) and, for OCERS, OHSO SORTPO_OCERS (CrashID, Street, IntersectingStreetName, CrashSeverity '(K) Fatal Injury' ... '(O) Property Damage-Only', Latitude, Longitude). Checked 2026-11-08; real export headers must be confirmed on one sample.
unit: COLLISION (one row per crash), UNIT, PERSON, linked by Collision ID

map.collision_id: Collision_ID (SAFE-T) / CrashID (OCERS); DOC_ID in OHSO's layers
map.primary_road: On_Street (city streets); Hwy_Name for state highways ('I-35', 'US-169', 'SH-11'), with Control section + Milepoint
map.sec_distance: none seen in any public copy (not measured whether SAFE-T exports one)
map.severity: SAFE-T Severity 1-5: 5/K Fatality, 4/A Incapacitating, 3/B Non-Incapacitating, 2/C Possible, 1/O Property Damage Only (SAFE-T Training p. 18). OCERS gives KABCO words directly; 'Unknown' -> U. OHSO's KAB layers label A Fatal / B Serious / C Minor: those letters are sort keys, not KABCO (Fatal = K, Serious = A, Minor = B)
map.surface: not seen in public copies (OCERS: RD_SURFACE_COND)
map.lat_lon: Latitude_Derived / Longitude_Derived (SAFE-T 'Not all crashes found are mappable', Training p. 102); 100% present on OHSO's 2021 Tulsa County rows
map.county_code: County (ODOT county number 1-77, alphabetical: Oklahoma = 55, Tulsa = 72, as in ODOT's Safety_Grid layer names)
map.is_freeway: Hwy_Class (codes; decode from the User Data Dictionary)
